sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast a podcast to practice your English listening for advanced Learners.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客，這是一​​個為高級學習者練習英語聽力的播客。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk about dreams don't be confused I don't mean dream as in your life goals and aspirations when I say dreams I'm referring to the dreams.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談夢想，不要混淆，我指的不是你的人生目標和願望中的夢想，當我說夢想時，我指的是夢想。

sentences.en: We sleep the worlds.
sentences.tc: 我們睡了整個世界。

sentences.en: We create in inside our brain our subconscious mind creating worlds creating stories creating our dreams while.
sentences.tc: 我們在大腦內部創造我們的潛意識，創造世界，創造故事，創造我們的夢想。

sentences.en: We sleep those are the dreams that.
sentences.tc: 我們睡覺時那些都是夢。

sentences.en: They are so mysterious I dream almost every night.
sentences.tc: 它們是如此神秘，我幾乎每天晚上都會夢見它們。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡它。

sentences.en: I love waking up from a crazy dream and writing it down in my dream journal it's a journal where I write down all of my dreams the moment.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡從瘋狂的夢中醒來，然後把它寫在我的夢想日記裡，這是我當時寫下所有夢想的日記。

sentences.en: I wake up.
sentences.tc: 我醒了。

sentences.en: I feel I can do anything have you ever had a dream that inspired.
sentences.tc: 我覺得我可以做任何有你曾經有過的夢想啟發的事情。

sentences.en: You to learn or do something I have also dreamt that I can fly have.
sentences.tc: 你去學習或做一些我也曾經夢想過的事情，我可以飛翔。

sentences.en: You ever had a dream where you could fly what did it feel like describe the feeling to me I'm.
sentences.tc: 你曾經有過一個可以飛翔的夢想，那是什麼感覺？請描述一下我的感覺。

sentences.en: I have had flying dreams before and it feels extraordinary the wind in my hair on my skin and the nervous feeling in my stomach like.
sentences.tc: 我以前也做過飛翔的夢，風吹過我的頭髮，吹過我的皮膚，還有我胃裡的緊張感，這種感覺非同尋常。

sentences.en: I might fall at any second it's exhilarating to feel like you're Flying high in the sky what's the coolest dream.
sentences.tc: 我可能隨時會墜落，感覺就像你在高空飛翔，這是最酷的夢想，這真是令人興奮。

sentences.en: You have ever had but I've also had very scary dreams I think.
sentences.tc: 你曾經做過，但我想我也曾經做過非常可怕的夢。

sentences.tc: 我們不斷地嘗試，但我們的腿就是動不了，這是你以前做過的可怕的夢。

sentences.en: What do you think that dream means I think dreams can have many meanings?
sentences.tc: 你認為這個夢意味著什麼 我認為夢可以有很多意義？

sentences.en: They can mean many different things I think dreams show us different signs maybe a sign that only our subconscious mind can pick up on dreams are very helpful for us.
sentences.tc: 它們可能意味著很多不同的事情，我認為夢向我們展示了不同的跡象，也許只有我們的潛意識才能捕捉到夢的跡象對我們非常有幫助。

sentences.en: They help us to get inspired and to get excited for new things.
sentences.tc: 它們幫助我們獲得靈感並對新事物感到興奮。
